LESSON: DATA SAFETY

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Foundations of Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 1.2: Data Safety
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Data Safety, part of Foundations of Pre-Technical Studies in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade 8 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: How is data protected in an electronic device?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Data Safety together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Critical Thinking and Problem Solving: learner acquires active listening and communication skills when discussing threats

to data in electronic devices

● Digital Literacy: learner acquires skills of interacting with technology when using digital devices to secure electronic data

in a user environment

Values:
● Responsibility: learner engages in assigned roles and duties when securing electronic data in the workplace against

possible threats.

● Respect: learner appreciates diverse opinions when brainstorming on the threats of electronic data in the work

environment.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Cyber Security: learner enhances online safety when practising how to secure electronic data in the user environment.

Link to other subjects:

• Mathematics: learner relates data safety to data handling in mathematics.

SECTION 6: SUMMARY

Main points to remember:


Remember the key question: How is data protected in an electronic device?
